# Elastic GPU research

Experiments on how GPU processes can start, idle and share memory more cheaply, from November 2026.

- `ABSTRACTION.md` states the result: separate the lifetimes of immutable device memory (segments), CUDA contexts and processes, and what each part buys. It also lists what is not proven.
- `LOG.md` has every result, failures included, with the hardware, the spend and the lessons.
- `scripts/` and `results/` hold the code and the data behind each result.
- `gvisor_issue_draft.md` and `NVPROXY_REVIEW.md` cover the gVisor change, [google/gvisor#16898](https://github.com/google/gvisor/pull/16898).

The segment library is now [gpu-segments](https://github.com/ziyangliu-666/gpu-segments). The scripts ran against the earlier copy inside [warmd](https://github.com/ziyangliu-666/warmd), commit 83cb5ea, checked out at `/workspace/warmd`, and they import `warmd.segments`. To rerun them, check out that commit.
